items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.snippet: AI agents can generate code at a scale that’s hard for humans to review line-by-line. PDD Kit helps ensure the code is doing what the developer intended by creating formal specifications and testing against them. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification, proves AI-generated code meets it for every input, and uses tests where proofs aren't practical. Developers review intent, not every line. The post Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit appeared first o
items.title_ar: Microsoft Research تتحقق رسمياً من تطبيقات الويب التي يكتبها agents
items.summary_ar: تقدم Microsoft Research أداة PDD Kit للتحقق الرسمي من تطبيقات الويب الكاملة التي يكتبها agents. تحوّل الأداة نية المطور إلى Verus specification ثم تثبت أن الكود يلبيها لكل مدخل. تُستخدم الاختبارات حيث لا تكون الإثباتات عملية.
items.why_ar: يهمك لأن مراجعة الكود المولد بالـ agents على نطاق واسع تحتاج منهجاً أدق من القراءة السطرية.
items.title_en: Microsoft Research formally verifies agent-written web apps
items.summary_en: Microsoft Research introduces PDD Kit to formally verify full-stack web apps written by agents. It converts developer intent into a Verus specification and proves AI-generated code meets it for every input. Tests are used where proofs are impractical.
items.why_en: It offers a path to reviewing agent-generated code by intent rather than line by line, which matters for governed banking environments.

items.title: SAE Interprets MoE: Sparse AutoEncoders Reveal That MoE Experts Exhibit Human-Interpretable Fine-Grained Specialization
items.snippet: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models route each token to a few of many experts, yet what an individual expert is responsible for remains unsettled. Existing analyses count how often an expert is selected on domain-labeled corpora, an instrument that fixes the taxonomy in advance, stays coarse, and records selection rather than contribution. We instead study specialization in feature space by training a sparse autoencoder (SAE) on the output of an MoE layer. Since this output is a router-weighted sum of expert outputs and the SAE encoder is affine, the pre-activation of every latent decomposes exactly over the experts. Aggregated over a corpus, this gives each expert a dominant set of latents whos
items.title_ar: Sparse Autoencoders تكشف تخصصاً دقيقاً لـ Experts في MoE
items.summary_ar: تدرس الورقة تخصص Experts في نماذج MoE عبر تدريب sparse autoencoder على مخرجات طبقة MoE بدلاً من عدّ مرات اختيار كل expert. يتيح هذا المنهج تفكيك الـ latents بدقة حسب كل expert. تشير النتائج إلى أن لكل expert مجموعة latents مهيمنة قابلة للتفسير البشري.
items.why_ar: يفيدك إن كنت تعمل على فهم أو تفسير نماذج MoE، وهو موضوع بحثي قابل للنشر والمتابعة.
items.title_en: Sparse autoencoders reveal fine-grained expert specialization in MoE
items.summary_en: The paper trains a sparse autoencoder on the output of an MoE layer to study expert specialization in feature space. Instead of counting expert selections on domain-labeled corpora, it decomposes latent pre-activations exactly over experts. The result is that each expert gets a dominant set of latents that are human-interpretable.
items.why_en: It offers a more precise interpretability method for MoE models relevant to your research work.

items.title: On the Opportunities and Challenges of Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-Model Transfer
items.snippet: Prefill-to-Autoregressive Cross-model Transfer (PACT), a form of latent communication between language models, combines a larger model's prompt representations with a smaller model's efficient generation, offering a promising way to balance capability and inference cost. However, existing systems provide limited support for independently evaluating large-small model collaboration, and improved task performance alone does not establish whether the receiver benefits from the sender's information. We introduce PLatour, an open-source PACT framework that connects frozen models through lightweight, zero-initialized linear bridges trained directly with task rewards and supports hybrid-attention ar
items.title_ar: PLatour: إطار open-source لنقل Prefill بين نموذج كبير وصغير
items.summary_ar: يقدم البحث PLatour، وهو إطار open-source لربط نماذج frozen عبر linear bridges خفيفة تُدرّب مباشرة بـ task rewards. يهدف الإطار إلى قياس ما إذا كان النموذج الصغير يستفيد فعلاً من معلومات النموذج الكبير، ويدعم hybrid-attention architectures. الفكرة تجمع قدرة النموذج الكبير مع كفاءة توليد النموذج الصغير.
items.why_ar: يمكنك تجربة الإطار مباشرة لبناء POC يوازن بين جودة النتائج وتكلفة inference في نماذج LLM داخل البنك.
items.title_en: PLatour: Open-Source Framework for Prefill-to-Autoregressive Transfer
items.summary_en: The paper introduces PLatour, an open-source framework that connects frozen models through lightweight zero-initialized linear bridges trained with task rewards. It measures whether the receiver model truly benefits from the sender's information and supports hybrid-attention architectures. The idea combines the capability of a large model with the efficient generation of a small one.
items.why_en: You could directly try this framework to build a POC balancing quality and inference cost for LLMs inside the bank.

items.title: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
items.snippet: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to provide continuous personalized assistance by retaining user information across interactions. Existing systems support this process through fact extraction, organization, updating, and retrieval, but largely maintain memories as independent facts. This fact-centric paradigm may overlook how new facts update, constrain, or conflict with earlier ones, while leaving their applicability, role, and priority for the current request implicit. In this paper, we introduce EvoMemState, a state-centric framework that augments persistent facts with two complementary states: Relational States that capture how facts remain valid and relate to o
items.title_ar: EvoMemState: ذاكرة قائمة على الحالة لـ personal agents
items.summary_ar: تقترح الورقة EvoMemState، وهو إطار ذاكرة يركز على الحالة state-centric بدلاً من تخزين الذكريات كحقائق مستقلة لدى LLM agents طويلة المدى. يضيف الإطار حالتين مكملتين للحقائق الدائمة، أولاهما Relational States التي تتتبع صلاحية الحقائق وعلاقتها ببعضها.
items.why_ar: مشكلات تعارض الذاكرة وتحديثها في personal agents تواجه أي مساعد مصرفي يحتفظ بسياق العميل عبر الجلسات.
items.title_en: EvoMemState: Evolving Memory State for Personal Agents
items.summary_en: The paper proposes EvoMemState, a state-centric memory framework for LLM agents that moves beyond storing memories as independent facts. It augments persistent facts with complementary states, starting with Relational States that track how facts remain valid and relate to each other.
items.why_en: Memory conflict and update handling is directly relevant to any stateful banking assistant you might build.

items.title: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making: A Shared Conditional Predictor for Agents
items.snippet: Agent decisions depend on empirical relationships that deployment observations reveal and task descriptions alone may leave unresolved. We introduce Decoupled Predictive Decision Making (DPDM), an architecture that formulates heterogeneous agent decisions as conditional prediction with a shared pretrained learner. Language models provide semantic representations of current and historical records, while a general-purpose conditional predictor predicts task-defined targets from the represented evidence. Pretraining supplies reusable inference capability; deployment evidence instantiates problem-specific predictions without updating either model's neural parameters. Tool judgments, candidate pr
items.title_ar: DPDM: مُتنبئ شرطي مشترك لقرارات agents
items.summary_ar: تقدم الورقة DPDM، وهي معمارية تصوغ قرارات agents غير المتجانسة كمهمة توقع شرطي باستخدام learner مشترك مُدرّب مسبقاً. تستخدم LLM لتمثيل السجلات الحالية والتاريخية، بينما يتنبأ predictor عام بالأهداف المعرّفة للمهمة دون تحديث أوزان النموذج.
items.why_ar: قد تفيدك في بناء agents تتخذ قرارات من بيانات التشغيل دون إعادة تدريب النموذج، وهو مهم للأنظمة البنكية الحساسة.
items.title_en: Decoupled Predictive Decision Making for Agents
items.summary_en: The paper introduces DPDM, an architecture that frames heterogeneous agent decisions as conditional prediction using a shared pretrained learner. LLMs encode current and historical records, while a general-purpose predictor forecasts task-defined targets without updating model weights.
items.why_en: It offers a way to drive agent decisions from deployment evidence without retraining, which suits production banking systems.

items.title: Balanov/uncut
items.snippet: The lossless, headless coding agent harness. One 7 MB static binary, four tools, plain stdin/stdout, no silent cuts.
items.title_ar: uncut: harness خفيف لـ coding agents
items.summary_ar: ريبو uncut يقدم coding agent harness في binary ثابت بحجم حوالي 7 MB، ويعتمد على أربع أدوات فقط عبر stdin وstdout. يتعهد الريبو بعدم قطع المخرجات بصمت، أي أنه lossless.
items.why_ar: أداة صغيرة يمكن تجربتها فوراً لبناء coding agent داخلي دون تبعيات ثقيلة.
items.title_en: uncut: A Lossless Headless Coding Agent Harness
items.summary_en: The uncut repo offers a lossless, headless coding agent harness packaged as a 7 MB static binary. It exposes four tools over plain stdin and stdout and avoids silent output truncation.
items.why_en: It is a lightweight coding agent you can test immediately in an internal developer workflow.

items.title: Perplexity launches its own take on AI agents for work
items.snippet: Perplexity is taking on OpenAI and Anthropic with its own work-focused AI agents. The startup's new always-on "Teammates" can take on multiple roles within a workspace, while pulling existing projects, skills, and memory from the Perplexity tools you already use. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, an AI system that can deploy agents on your device […]
items.title_ar: Perplexity تطلق Teammates كوكلاء عمل دائمي التشغيل
items.summary_ar: تنافس Perplexity كلاً من OpenAI وAnthropic بإطلاق Teammates، وهي agents دائمة التشغيل تؤدي أدواراً متعددة داخل workspace. تستطيع استخدام المشاريع والمهارات والذاكرة من أدوات Perplexity الحالية. تتكامل مع Perplexity Computer الذي ينشر agents على الجهاز.
items.why_ar: يوضح اتجاه agents في بيئات العمل المؤسسية، وهو قريب من تصميم حلول agents داخل البنك.
items.title_en: Perplexity launches Teammates, always-on work agents
items.summary_en: Perplexity is competing with OpenAI and Anthropic with Teammates, always-on agents that take on multiple roles within a workspace. They draw on existing projects, skills, and memory from Perplexity tools. Teammates integrate with Perplexity Computer, which can deploy agents on your device.
items.why_en: It signals where workplace agent products are heading, relevant to designing internal agent solutions.
